channel.title: Salah Alkmali — Writing
channel.description: Articles on math, education, and building things by Salah Alkmali.

item.title: The Day-After Test
item.description: What you can solve tomorrow, on a blank page, with no notes — that's what you actually learned today. A 10-minute habit for math students.

item.title: I Did My Best — So Why Are My Marks Still Low?
item.description: Discover why working hard isn't always enough and learn the real difference between "Homework Heroes" and "Steady Achievers." Stop memorizing and start understanding.

item.title: Speed Math Battle: Making Math Fun for Kids
item.description: A fast-paced, competitive math game that transforms learning into an exciting adventure. See how two-player battles make math practice engaging and fun.

item.title: Building Educational Tools That Actually Teach
item.description: How I built an animated equation solver that shows students the process, not just the answer. A look at what it really means to design an educational tool that actually teaches.

item.title: Can a Game Really Change How Students Learn? I Think So.
item.description: A teacher's honest reflection on how classroom games transformed student engagement and sparked the creation of MATHLOGAME. Can play really change how students learn?

item.title: So ... Why Are We Even Learning This?
item.description: A candid letter about why math matters, how it shapes your thinking, and why you don't have to love it to get stronger at it.

item.title: Are You Using AI the Right Way?
item.description: A practical guide for students on how to use AI as a tool for genuine learning, not just shortcuts. Discover the difference between smart and lazy use of AI in your studies.
